title: Income cutoff and subsidy program participation
research_question: Does eligibility for a housing subsidy (income below threshold) increase housing expenditure, using income just below vs. just above the eligibility cutoff?
data_description: Cross-sectional data on 600 households. Variables: running_var (income/threshold ratio, 0–1; cutoff = 0.5), treated (1 if income ≤ threshold i.e. running_var ≤ 0.5), y (housing expenditure share), near_cutoff. Must check for income manipulation at threshold (McCrary test).

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Sharp RDD — income cutoff; test for manipulation; local linear; optimal bandwidth (IK or CCT)
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Eligible households increase housing expenditure share
ground_truth.main_effect: ~25pp increase in housing spend for eligible households
